snippet.title: Voltage High Society - The Haunted Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Voltage High Society Now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2063480/Voltage_High_Society/

Join the Community:
https://discord.gg/Zmu7s9f2Qh

The whispers from the island's heart have become a scream. Prepare for the Haunted Update, the biggest and most terrifying chapter of Voltage High Society yet!

💀 New Horrifying Monsters: Twisted abominations stalk the corrupted lands.
☣️ Lethal Environmental Hazards: The island itself wants you dead.
⚙️ Game-Changing New Mechanics: Discover new ways to survive the nightmare.

The final confrontation is almost here. After the Haunted Update, only one level remains before our full 1.0 release later this year. Will you uncover the truth, or will the plague claim you?
